category_edits.rationale: Apply parameter-free RMS normalization to input item embeddings before existing dropout for all four datasets. Consistent input magnitudes may stabilize GRU gates. Padding stays zero; embedding width, tying, candidate embeddings, scoring, GRU topology, loss, and optimizer remain unchanged. The generated predictor already imports GRU4RecModel from train.py, so it automatically uses the same normalization without writer changes.
